## SUMMARY
**Legacy fill flow.** `QuestionnaireForm` (src/components/Questionnaire/QuestionnaireForm.tsx) is the only fill host. It holds `QuestionnaireFormState[] = {questionnaire, responses: QuestionnaireResponse[], errors}` in `useState`, seeds via local `initializeResponses` (walks the tree, one flat response per non-group question, seeds `answer_option.initial_selected`), and renders one `QuestionRenderer` per form. `QuestionRenderer` → `QuestionGroup` (recursive, evaluates `isQuestionEnabled` and clears responses of newly-disabled subtrees in an effect) → `QuestionInput` (repeats loop, note popovers, per-type switch that also re-checks encounterId/facilityId and renders `t("questionnaire_*_no_encounter")` strings when missing).

**Submit.** `handleSubmit` (line 743) clears errors, runs required-field validation plus `STRUCTURED_TYPE_VALIDATORS` (appointment/encounter/medication_statement/medication_request/files — validators are *exported from the component files themselves*), scrolls to `#question-<id>`, then builds a `FormBatchRequest[]`: first structured requests via `getStructuredRequests(structured_type, values[0].value as array, {facilityId, patientId, encounterId})` from src/components/Questionnaire/structured/handlers.ts (each returns raw `{url, method, body, reference_id}`, reference_id === the structured type; medication_request/diagnosis filter on `dirty`; files base64-encodes), then one `POST /api/v1/questionnaire/{id}/submit/` per form with `{resource_id: encounterId ?? patientId, encounter, patient, results:[{question_id, values, note, body_site, method}]}` (date→`dateQueryString`, dateTime→ISO, unit/coding branches), then optionally a `PUT /api/v1/form_submission/{draftId}/` with status submitted. All posted through `batchApi.batchRequest` (deprecated; `mutate(..., {silent:true})`, error `cause.results` decoded into `ServerValidationError[]`). Drafts (`careConfig.enableQuestionnaireDraft`, only when the questionnaire has **no** structured questions) POST/PUT `/api/v1/form_submission/` and then **`navigate(...)` to the encounter updates page**.

**Mount sites.** `QuestionnaireForm` is only mounted by `EncounterQuestionnaire` (src/components/Patient/EncounterQuestionnaire.tsx), which is wired in src/Routers/routes/ConsultationRoutes.tsx at 5 paths (`…/encounter/:encounterId/questionnaire[/:questionnaireId]`, `…/patient/:patientId/consultation`, `…/patient/:patientId/questionnaire`, `/patient/:patientId/questionnaire`). `onSubmit` navigates to `/updates`.

**Mounting structured components elsewhere.** `STRUCTURED_REGISTRY` already declares the context each needs; `StructuredQuestionSlot` renders a dashed placeholder when `subject[key]` is missing. Providers actually required: QueryClientProvider (all), i18n, sonner `<Toaster/>` (App.tsx), and **AuthUserContext** — `useAuthUser()` *throws* and is called by MedicationRequestQuestion, ServiceRequestQuestion, AppointmentQuestion. **No react-hook-form anywhere** — zero `useForm`/`FormProvider`/`useFormContext` in QuestionTypes; state is plain `useState` + the update callback. PermissionContext is not used by any structured component (only `useCanWriteQuestionnaire`); `PermissionProvider` wraps everything in AppRouter.tsx:137 anyway. raviger location is read implicitly: `useQueryParams` in MedicationRequestQuestion (`?prescription`) and EncounterQuestion (`?toDischarge=true`), and `useFullPath` inside `useCurrentFacilitySilently`.

**Biggest trap:** MedicationRequestQuestion **ignores the `facilityId` prop** and derives it from the URL via `useCurrentFacilitySilently()` (src/pages/Facility/utils/useCurrentFacility.tsx), as do ValueSetSearchContent and MedicationValueSetSelect. Under `/admin/questionnaires/:id/edit` facilityId is `undefined`, so facility-scoped valueset/medication/template lookups silently degrade; only the facility-settings builder route gets a real id. That hook also calls `useFullPath()` then throws *before* `useQuery`, so hook counts differ between facility and non-facility paths — navigating across that boundary without remount trips React.

**Side effects a preview host must guard.** Allergy/Symptom/Diagnosis/MedicationStatement/MedicationRequest each fetch the patient's existing records on mount and immediately write them into the response via `updateQuestionnaireResponseCB`; the only escape hatch is the sentinel `patientId === "preview"` (`enabled: !isPreview`, `disableAPI={isPreview}` on HistoricalRecordSelector). EncounterQuestion has **no** preview guard: it GETs the encounter, honours `?toDischarge=true` by forcing status DISCHARGED, and mutates `period.end` in an effect. FileQuestion writes `[{type:"files", value: []}]` on mount and mounts camera/audio capture dialogs. ChargeItemQuestion's auto-add effect lists `updateQuestionnaireResponseCB` and `chargeItems` in its deps — the slot passes a fresh inline arrow each render, a real loop hazard. Add-to-template flows in MedicationRequest/ServiceRequest issue real POSTs and toasts. AppointmentQuestion uses the global `scheduleServiceTypeAtom`, which resolves against the renderer's private Jotai store (RendererContext), isolating it from the rest of the app. No structured component navigates.


## CONTRACTS
- Structured prop bag (what StructuredQuestionSlot passes and every legacy component structurally accepts): {question, questionnaireResponse, updateQuestionnaireResponseCB(values: ResponseValue[], questionId: string, note?: string), disabled, errors, clearError, index, withLabel, patientId, encounterId, facilityId}. There is no shared TS type — the registry stores ComponentType<any>; each component declares its own Props with different required/optional subsets, so extra props are silently ignored and missing ones are only caught at runtime.
- questionnaireResponse must be a single QuestionnaireResponse object for that question and must exist before the component mounts. StructuredQuestionSlot returns null when the store has no entry; every structured component reads its payload from questionnaireResponse.values[0].value as an ARRAY (Allergy/Symptom/Diagnosis/Medication*/Encounter/Appointment/ChargeItem/ServiceRequest/Files/TimeOfDeath) and writes back the whole array in one ResponseValue of type === the structured_type.
- updateQuestionnaireResponseCB must be stable or ChargeItemQuestion loops: its auto-add effect lists updateQuestionnaireResponseCB and chargeItems in the dependency array, and the slot currently creates a fresh inline arrow every render. Memoize the callback per questionId before adding more structured hosts.
- clearError is a REQUIRED prop of EncounterQuestion (typed `clearError: () => void`); the slot passes a no-op. errors defaults to [] in several components but is required (non-optional) in FileQuestion, AppointmentQuestion and MedicationStatementQuestion.
- questionnaireId/questionnaireSlug are part of the legacy contract but NOT in the slot's bag. Without questionnaireSlug, MedicationRequestQuestion and ServiceRequestQuestion silently drop the ManageResponseTemplatesSheet, and their template list query stays disabled (`enabled: !!questionnaireSlug && …`).
- MedicationRequestQuestion ignores its facilityId prop entirely and derives it from the URL via useCurrentFacilitySilently(); the same is true of ValueSetSearchContent and MedicationValueSetSelect. Any host not mounted under /facility/:facilityId/... gets facilityId === undefined, degrading valueset search, medication list (facility query param) and template queries.
- useCurrentFacilitySilently calls useFullPath() and then throws before useQuery() on non-facility paths, so React's hook count differs between /facility/... and /admin/... routes. A component instance must not survive navigation across that boundary — remount instead.
- useAuthUser() THROWS when AuthUserContext has no user. MedicationRequestQuestion, ServiceRequestQuestion and AppointmentQuestion will crash any host (test harness, storybook, isolated preview) without AuthUserProvider. ServiceRequestQuestion also stamps service_request.requester from the current user, which handlers.ts flattens to requester.id at submit time.
- No structured component uses react-hook-form: there is no useForm / FormProvider / useFormContext anywhere in src/components/Questionnaire/QuestionTypes. Do not wrap them in a FormProvider expecting integration; all state flows through useState + updateQuestionnaireResponseCB.
- Required providers for a structured mount: QueryClientProvider (TanStack), i18next (useTranslation), sonner <Toaster/> (toasts fire from Medication/ServiceRequest/Symptom/Diagnosis), AuthUserProvider (3 components), and an SPA URL raviger can read (useQueryParams/useFullPath). PermissionContext is NOT needed by structured components; it is only used by useCanWriteQuestionnaire in the builder.
- `patientId === "preview"` is the existing sentinel that makes Allergy/Symptom/Diagnosis/MedicationStatement/MedicationRequest inert: it sets `enabled: !isPreview` on the seed queries and `disableAPI={isPreview}` on HistoricalRecordSelector. A preview host must pass that literal (LocationSearch and DeviceSelector use the same convention with facilityId). The legacy QuestionRenderer additionally treats encounterId === "preview" as force-disabled and hides the submit/search UI.
- EncounterQuestion has NO preview guard: on mount it GETs /api/v1/encounter/{id}?facility={facilityId} (needs both), pushes the server encounter into the response, force-sets status to DISCHARGED when the host URL carries ?toDischarge=true, and mutates period.end whenever status becomes a terminal one. Do not mount it in a builder preview without a real encounter or a new guard.
- FileQuestion writes `[{type:"files", value: []}]` into the response on first render (effect on fileUpload.files) — any dirty-tracking host will be marked dirty immediately by merely rendering a files question.
- MedicationRequestQuestion reads ?prescription from the URL and, when present, replaces the response with the fetched prescription's medications; EncounterQuestion reads ?toDischarge. A builder host whose URL happens to carry those params changes structured behaviour — strip or namespace query params.
- Add-to-template flows (AddToTemplateDialog + create/add mutations in MedicationRequestQuestion and ServiceRequestQuestion) perform real POSTs to the questionnaire_response_template API and fire toasts; the dialogs are always mounted, only their data query is slug-gated. A preview host must disable these or accept live writes.
- AppointmentQuestion uses the global jotai scheduleServiceTypeAtom (atomWithStorage). Because QuestionnaireRendererProvider wraps children in its own <JotaiProvider store={…}>, the atom resolves against that private store — value is read from localStorage per store but is not shared live with the rest of the app.
- Submit contract: structured answers never go to /questionnaire/{id}/submit/. QuestionnaireForm routes them through getStructuredRequests(structured_type, values[0].value as array, {facilityId, patientId, encounterId}) and appends only non-structured responses with values.length > 0 && values[0].value !== "" to the questionnaire submit body, further filtered by isQuestionEnabled. Structured requests are pushed BEFORE the questionnaire submit in the same batch.
- Batch reference_id conventions: structured requests use the structured type string ("allergy_intolerance", "medication_request", …), questionnaire submits use form.questionnaire.id, and the draft finalize uses `form_submission_{draftId}`. The error decoder maps reference_id back to a form title or, for structured errors, scrolls to the question via findStructuredQuestionId over form.responses.structured_type.
- Value serialization at submit: type "date" → dateQueryString(new Date(value)) (invalid dates become ""), type "dateTime" → value.toISOString(), value.unit present → {value: String, unit, coding}, value.coding only → {coding}, otherwise {value: String(value)}. Any new submit path must reproduce this or the backend will reject.
- Structured submit filtering happens inside handlers.ts, not the UI: medication_request only submits rows with `dirty === true` (and stamps create_prescription with an alternate_identifier `${encounterId}-${iso}`), diagnosis likewise filters on dirty, allergy/symptom/medication_statement submit everything, files base64-encode file_data via readFileAsDataURL, and the encounter handler THROWS 'Cannot create encounter without a facility' when facilityId is missing.
- Draft save is only offered when careConfig.enableQuestionnaireDraft is on, exactly one form is loaded, and the questionnaire contains NO structured question anywhere in the tree (isDraftSaveable). On success it flushSync-clears dirty and navigate()s to /facility/{f}/patient/{p}/encounter/{e}/updates — a builder-preview host must not reuse that mutation, or it will navigate away.
- QuestionnaireForm is mounted only from EncounterQuestionnaire (src/components/Patient/EncounterQuestionnaire.tsx), which is registered at 5 raviger paths in ConsultationRoutes.tsx; onSubmit there navigates to the encounter/patient /updates page. useNavigationPrompt(isDirty && !import.meta.env.DEV) blocks navigation while dirty.
- FIXED_QUESTIONNAIRES (keyed by slug in StructuredFormData.tsx) short-circuits the questionnaire detail fetch: when questionnaireId matches a structured slug the form uses the synthetic single-question questionnaire and never calls questionnaireApi.get.

1	## SUMMARY
2	**Bottom line: care_fe has NO semantic CSS-variable design-token layer.** None of the reference-design vars (`--background`, `--soft-background`, `--muted-background`, `--strong-background`, `--border`, `--soft-border`, `--strong-border`, `--input`, `--foreground`, `--soft-foreground`, `--muted-foreground`, `--placeholder-foreground`, `--disabled-foreground`, `--primary`, `--primary-foreground`, `--popover`, `--card`, `--destructive`) exist anywhere in the repo — a grep across `src/`, `apps/`, `plugins/` for all of them returns zero hits. This is deliberate: `components.json` sets `"cssVariables": false` and `"baseColor": "gray"`, so shadcn components were generated with **literal Tailwind gray/white utilities** instead of `bg-background`/`text-foreground`. Any new code must follow the same convention or it will render unstyled.
3	
4	**Where theme lives.** Tailwind v4 (`tailwindcss ^4.1.3`, `@tailwindcss/vite`) but in *hybrid* mode: `src/style/index.css` does `@import "tailwindcss"` + `@import "tw-animate-css"` + `@config "../../tailwind.config.js"`, so the palette is defined in a **v3-style JS config**, not `@theme`. The only `@theme` block in the whole repo (index.css:112–145) defines three alias ramps: `--color-warning-*` → amber, `--color-alert-*` → violet, `--color-danger-*` → red (50–900 each). The only `:root` block (index.css:732–744) holds `--radius: 0.5rem` plus eight HSL sidebar vars (`--sidebar-background`, `--sidebar-foreground`, `--sidebar-primary`, `--sidebar-primary-foreground`, `--sidebar-accent`, `--sidebar-accent-foreground`, `--sidebar-border: transparent`, `--sidebar-ring`) — these are the *only* semantic tokens that exist, and they're consumed as `bg-sidebar-accent` / `text-sidebar-accent-foreground` etc. `tailwind.config.js` also aliases bare `border`/`ring`/`accent-foreground` to those sidebar vars (so a naked `border-border` maps to `transparent`, a trap).
5	
6	**Primary color = emerald-ish green, hardcoded hex in `tailwind.config.js`:** `primary.DEFAULT/500 = #0d9f6e`, 100 `#def7ec`, 200 `#bcf0da`, 300 `#84e1bc`, 400 `#31c48d`, 600 `#057a55`, **700 `#046c4e` (the canonical button/tab/active color)**, 800 `#03543F`, 900 `#014737`. **There is no `primary-50`** — yet 24 call sites use `bg-primary-50` / `hover:bg-primary-50` (incl. `SegmentedRadioGroup.tsx:66`, `ChoiceChip.tsx:30`, `Calendar.tsx:143`). I verified against the built CSS (`build/assets/index-D2U2cK_2.css`): `bg-primary-100` and `text-primary-800` are emitted, `bg-primary-50` is **not** — those classes are silently dead. Use `bg-primary-100` instead. `secondary.*` is a separate purple-gray ramp (50 `#F9FAFB` → 900 `#453C52`); `body` color is hardcoded `#453C52`.
7	
8	**Reference vars → care_fe equivalents.** `--background`→`bg-white`; `--soft-background`→`bg-gray-50`; `--muted-background`→`bg-gray-100`; `--strong-background`→`bg-gray-200`; `--border`→`border-gray-200`; `--soft-border`→`border-gray-100`; `--strong-border`→`border-gray-300`; `--input`→`border-gray-300` (see `input.tsx`); `--foreground`→`text-gray-950` (headings `text-gray-900`); `--soft-foreground`→`text-gray-700`; `--muted-foreground`→`text-gray-500`; `--placeholder-foreground`→`placeholder:text-gray-500` / `data-[placeholder]:text-gray-500`; `--disabled-foreground`→ no color token, it's `disabled:opacity-50` + `disabled:cursor-not-allowed`; `--primary`→`bg-primary-700`; `--primary-foreground`→`text-white`; `--popover`/`--card`→`bg-white text-gray-950 border-gray-200`; `--destructive`→`bg-red-500 text-gray-50` (button) or `text-red-500` (menu item). **The `--color-*` palette vars you listed all exist** as Tailwind v4 defaults: emerald-50/700 (and 900), amber-50/700, indigo-50/700, sky-50/700, teal-50/700, red-50/700, neutral-300 are valid — I confirmed emerald/indigo/sky/teal/red vars are emitted in the built CSS where used. Access them as utilities (`bg-emerald-50`), not `var(--color-emerald-50)`. `teal-50` and `neutral-300` aren't currently used anywhere but would compile fine; note the codebase uses `gray-*` not `neutral-*` throughout.

Popover, DropdownMenu, Select, Tabs, Switch, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Collapsible, Dialog, Sheet, Drawer (vaul), Command (cmdk), HoverCard, ContextMenu, Menubar, Tooltip, ScrollArea, Slider, Progress, Separator, Accordion, AlertDialog. **No `toggle.tsx` / `toggle-group.tsx`** — `@radix-ui/react-toggle` and `-toggle-group` are NOT installed. ## SUMMARY
**Bottom line: care_fe has NO semantic CSS-variable design-token layer.** None of the reference-design vars (`--background`, `--soft-background`, `--muted-background`, `--strong-background`, `--border`, `--soft-border`, `--strong-border`, `--input`, `--foreground`, `--soft-foreground`, `--muted-foreground`, `--placeholder-foreground`, `--disabled-foreground`, `--primary`, `--primary-foreground`, `--popover`, `--card`, `--destructive`) exist anywhere in the repo — a grep across `src/`, `apps/`, `plugins/` for all of them returns zero hits. This is deliberate: `components.json` sets `"cssVariables": false` and `"baseColor": "gray"`, so shadcn components were generated with **literal Tailwind gray/white utilities** instead of `bg-background`/`text-foreground`. Any new code must follow the same convention or it will render unstyled.

**Where theme lives.** Tailwind v4 (`tailwindcss ^4.1.3`, `@tailwindcss/vite`) but in *hybrid* mode: `src/style/index.css` does `@import "tailwindcss"` + `@import "tw-animate-css"` + `@config "../../tailwind.config.js"`, so the palette is defined in a **v3-style JS config**, not `@theme`. The only `@theme` block in the whole repo (index.css:112–145) defines three alias ramps: `--color-warning-*` → amber, `--color-alert-*` → violet, `--color-danger-*` → red (50–900 each). The only `:root` block (index.css:732–744) holds `--radius: 0.5rem` plus eight HSL sidebar vars (`--sidebar-background`, `--sidebar-foreground`, `--sidebar-primary`, `--sidebar-primary-foreground`, `--sidebar-accent`, `--sidebar-accent-foreground`, `--sidebar-border: transparent`, `--sidebar-ring`) — these are the *only* semantic tokens that exist, and they're consumed as `bg-sidebar-accent` / `text-sidebar-accent-foreground` etc. `tailwind.config.js` also aliases bare `border`/`ring`/`accent-foreground` to those sidebar vars (so a naked `border-border` maps to `transparent`, a trap).

**Primary color = emerald-ish green, hardcoded hex in `tailwind.config.js`:** `primary.DEFAULT/500 = #0d9f6e`, 100 `#def7ec`, 200 `#bcf0da`, 300 `#84e1bc`, 400 `#31c48d`, 600 `#057a55`, **700 `#046c4e` (the canonical button/tab/active color)**, 800 `#03543F`, 900 `#014737`. **There is no `primary-50`** — yet 24 call sites use `bg-primary-50` / `hover:bg-primary-50` (incl. `SegmentedRadioGroup.tsx:66`, `ChoiceChip.tsx:30`, `Calendar.tsx:143`). I verified against the built CSS (`build/assets/index-D2U2cK_2.css`): `bg-primary-100` and `text-primary-800` are emitted, `bg-primary-50` is **not** — those classes are silently dead. Use `bg-primary-100` instead. `secondary.*` is a separate purple-gray ramp (50 `#F9FAFB` → 900 `#453C52`); `body` color is hardcoded `#453C52`.

**Reference vars → care_fe equivalents.** `--background`→`bg-white`; `--soft-background`→`bg-gray-50`; `--muted-background`→`bg-gray-100`; `--strong-background`→`bg-gray-200`; `--border`→`border-gray-200`; `--soft-border`→`border-gray-100`; `--strong-border`→`border-gray-300`; `--input`→`border-gray-300` (see `input.tsx`); `--foreground`→`text-gray-950` (headings `text-gray-900`); `--soft-foreground`→`text-gray-700`; `--muted-foreground`→`text-gray-500`; `--placeholder-foreground`→`placeholder:text-gray-500` / `data-[placeholder]:text-gray-500`; `--disabled-foreground`→ no color token, it's `disabled:opacity-50` + `disabled:cursor-not-allowed`; `--primary`→`bg-primary-700`; `--primary-foreground`→`text-white`; `--popover`/`--card`→`bg-white text-gray-950 border-gray-200`; `--destructive`→`bg-red-500 text-gray-50` (button) or `text-red-500` (menu item). **The `--color-*` palette vars you listed all exist** as Tailwind v4 defaults: emerald-50/700 (and 900), amber-50/700, indigo-50/700, sky-50/700, teal-50/700, red-50/700, neutral-300 are valid — I confirmed emerald/indigo/sky/teal/red vars are emitted in the built CSS where used. Access them as utilities (`bg-emerald-50`), not `var(--color-emerald-50)`. `teal-50` and `neutral-300` aren't currently used anywhere but would compile fine; note the codebase uses `gray-*` not `neutral-*` throughout.

**Radix wrappers available** (see file list). Popover, DropdownMenu, Select, Tabs, Switch, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Collapsible, Dialog, Sheet, Drawer (vaul), Command (cmdk), HoverCard, ContextMenu, Menubar, Tooltip, ScrollArea, Slider, Progress, Separator, Accordion, AlertDialog. **No `toggle.tsx` / `toggle-group.tsx`** — `@radix-ui/react-toggle` and `-toggle-group` are NOT installed. Segmented controls are hand-rolled: `SegmentedRadioGroup.tsx` (roving-tabindex `role="radiogroup"`, `gap-px` over `bg-gray-200` for dividers, active = `bg-primary-50 text-primary-800` — note the dead `primary-50`), and `EditPreviewToggle.tsx` (pill toggle: `rounded-full bg-gray-100 p-1`, active pill `bg-white text-gray-900 shadow-sm`). Tab conventions: base `Tabs` is a shadcn pill list, but the repo's real pattern is the **underline variant** used by both `nav-tabs.tsx` and `filter-tabs.tsx`: list `border-b rounded-none bg-transparent p-0 h-auto`, trigger `border-b-3 text-gray-600 data-[state=active]:border-b-primary-700 data-[state=active]:text-primary-800 data-[state=active]:bg-transparent data-[state=active]:shadow-none`. Both also implement overflow-to-DropdownMenu ("N more"). A global rule in index.css:697 forces `[data-slot="tabs-trigger"]` inactive text to `text-gray-500`.

**A working 3-pane questionnaire builder already exists** at `src/components/QuestionnaireV2/builder/` + `renderer/` + `shared/` — reuse it rather than rebuilding: `QuestionnaireBuilderPage.tsx` (w-72 sticky tree nav + flex-1 editor + sticky bottom action bar, mobile falls back to a `Select`), `QuestionTreeNav.tsx`, `questionTypeIcons.ts` (type→lucide icon + `bg-X-100 text-X-700` tint), `QuestionTypeBadge.tsx`, `CollapsibleSettingsCard.tsx`, `ChoiceChip.tsx`, `LabeledActionButton.tsx`.

## CONTRACTS
- NO semantic CSS design tokens exist. --background, --soft-background, --muted-background, --strong-background, --border, --soft-border, --strong-border, --input, --foreground, --soft-foreground, --muted-foreground, --placeholder-foreground, --disabled-foreground, --primary, --primary-foreground, --popover, --card, --destructive: ZERO hits repo-wide. Writing bg-background / text-foreground / border-input / bg-card / text-destructive will silently produce no CSS.
- components.json sets "cssVariables": false and "baseColor": "gray". Any component pulled from shadcn CLI/registry MUST be converted to literal gray/white utilities before use, or it will render unstyled.
- bg-primary-50 / hover:bg-primary-50 / bg-primary-50/50 is a DEAD CLASS — tailwind.config.js defines primary only at 100..900 + DEFAULT, with no 50. Verified absent from build/assets/index-D2U2cK_2.css while bg-primary-100 is present. 24 existing call sites are silently broken. Use bg-primary-100 in new code.
- Primary is #0d9f6e (500/DEFAULT). The canonical interactive primary is primary-700 (#046c4e) — buttons, active tab underline, radio dots. primary-800 (#03543F) is the active-tab text color.
- tailwind.config.js aliases bare border, ring and accent-foreground to the sidebar HSL vars, and --sidebar-border is `transparent`. So `border-border` renders a transparent border. Always name the shade explicitly: border-gray-200 / border-gray-300.
- The default border color is reset in index.css @layer base to var(--color-gray-200) for *, ::after, ::before, ::backdrop, ::file-selector-button — a bare `border` class gives a gray-200 border. Do not rely on this if the element also matches a Tailwind border-color utility.
- This is Tailwind v4 running in hybrid mode: @import "tailwindcss" + @config "../../tailwind.config.js". Colors go in tailwind.config.js (v3 syntax), NOT in @theme. The only @theme block defines the warning/alert/danger alias ramps.
- Semantic ramps that DO exist as utilities: warning-50..900 (= amber), alert-50..900 (= violet), danger-50..900 (= red). Prefer bg-warning-100/text-warning-900 over raw amber for status UI; Button already has `warning` and `alert` variants.
- Tailwind v4 default palette vars (--color-emerald-*, --color-amber-*, --color-indigo-*, --color-sky-*, --color-teal-*, --color-red-*, --color-neutral-*) are all available. Consume them as utility classes (bg-emerald-50), not as var(--color-emerald-50) — the vars are only emitted for classes actually used by the JIT scan.
- The codebase uses gray-* exclusively; neutral-* has ZERO usages. Prefer gray-300 over neutral-300 for consistency.
- No Radix Toggle or ToggleGroup is installed (@radix-ui/react-toggle / -toggle-group absent from package.json, no ui/toggle.tsx). Segmented controls must be hand-rolled — copy SegmentedRadioGroup.tsx (role=radiogroup + roving tabindex + ArrowLeft/Right per ARIA APG) or EditPreviewToggle.tsx (rounded-full bg-gray-100 p-1 pill).
- The repo's real tab look is the underline variant, not the shadcn pill: TabsList `w-full justify-evenly sm:justify-start border-b rounded-none bg-transparent p-0 h-auto overflow-x-auto`; TabsTrigger `border-b-3 px-1.5 sm:px-2.5 py-2 text-gray-600 font-semibold hover:text-gray-900 data-[state=active]:border-b-primary-700 data-[state=active]:text-primary-800 data-[state=active]:bg-transparent data-[state=active]:shadow-none rounded-none`.
- index.css has GLOBAL data-slot overrides that will affect any new Radix wrapper: [data-slot=tabs-trigger] forces not-active text-gray-500; [data-slot=popover-trigger] forces px-3; button[role=combobox] forces w-full; [data-slot=dialog-overlay] is bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-xs (white, not black); [data-slot=command-input-wrapper] gets border-b-0; button[role=radio] gets data-[state=checked]:border-primary-500 + text-primary-500 + border-gray-300 shadow-sm; [data-slot=form-label][aria-required=true] auto-appends a red asterisk.
- darkMode is "class" and every ui/ component carries dark: variants, but nothing ever adds the `dark` class to documentElement (only next-themes inside sonner.tsx reads a theme). Dark mode is effectively dead — do not spend effort on dark: variants, but match the existing style if copying components.
- CAREUI/interactive icons exist but CLAUDE.md says use lucide-react unless explicitly told otherwise. lucide-react is ^1.17.0.
- src/components/ui/ is declared off-limits for direct modification in CLAUDE.md — extend via className/cn() or wrap in a new component instead of editing primitives.
- cn() from @/lib/utils (twMerge(clsx())) must be used for all conditional/mergeable classNames; last-wins conflict resolution is relied on by every variant override.
- All user-facing strings must go through i18next (useTranslation/t) with English added to public/locale/en.json. Non-English is Crowdin-managed — never edit those files.
- A working 3-pane questionnaire builder already exists at src/components/QuestionnaireV2/{builder,renderer,shared}/ with a builderReducer, saveValidation, QuestionTreeNav, type-icon registry, and an edit/preview toggle. shared/ must never import from builder/ (documented invariant in questionTypeIcons.ts).
- Sidebar semantic tokens are the ONLY var-driven ones and they are raw HSL triplets consumed via hsl(var(--sidebar-*)) in tailwind.config.js — if you add tokens, follow either that pattern or (better) move to a real @theme block, but do not mix.
- Radius scale is driven by --radius: 0.5rem — rounded-lg = 0.5rem, rounded-md = calc(--radius - 2px), rounded-sm = calc(--radius - 4px). Cards use rounded-xl (a raw Tailwind value, not derived from --radius).
- Font is Figtree (self-hosted via @fontsource, weights 300-900) mapped to font-sans; body text color is a hardcoded #453c52 plus text-secondary-900.
- Prettier runs prettier-plugin-tailwindcss + prettier-plugin-organize-imports on staged files via husky — class order and import order will be rewritten on commit; don't hand-tune them.

content.content:
1	## SUMMARY
2	**Shell.** `QuestionnaireBuilderPage` (props `{scope: QuestionnaireScope, id: string}`) is mounted at `/facility/:fid/settings/questionnaires/:id/edit` (src/pages/Facility/settings/layout.tsx:283) and `/admin/questionnaires/:id/edit` (src/Routers/routes/adminRoutes.tsx:39). It fetches via `useQuery(questionnaireKeys.detail(id))`, holds ALL edit state in `useReducer(builderReducer, {questions:[], selectedId:null, dirty:false})`, and re-seeds from the server only when `questionnaire` changes AND `!state.dirty` (guard against refetch clobbering edits). Query params: `?mode=preview` seeds the view, `?import=1` opens the import dialog then is stripped from the URL on mount. `useNavigationPrompt(state.dirty, t("unsaved_changes_warning"))` is the only "discard" protection — the Cancel button is a plain `navigate(backPath)` with **no reducer-level revert**. Save = `findFirstInvalidQuestion(state.questions)` → on failure `toast.error(t(messageKey))` + `dispatch({type:"select"})` + `setView("edit")`; on success `save(buildUpdateBody(questionnaire, {questions}))` through `useUpdateQuestionnaire(id, onSaved)` whose `onSaved` dispatches `reset` with `keepSelectedId` so the author keeps their place. Save is `disabled={!state.dirty || isPending}` and gated on `canWrite`.
3	
4	**Layout today is 2-pane, one-question-at-a-time.** Header strip: Back + `EditPreviewToggle` | Cancel link + Save Changes. Edit view: `w-72` sticky left `BuilderTreeNav` (`md:` only) + a `md:hidden` `<Select>` mobile fallback + `flex-1` column holding a single `QuestionEditorCard` (or `BuilderEmptyState`) and a sticky bottom Previous / Add new question / Next bar that paginates **top-level questions only** via `findTopLevelIndex`. Preview view swaps the whole body for `QuestionnaireRenderer` fed a `useMemo`'d `{...questionnaire, questions: state.questions}` — that memo identity is load-bearing (the renderer's jotai store re-seeds and wipes in-progress preview answers on identity change).
5	
6	**State flow reducer→cards is uniform and shallow.** `QuestionEditorCard` derives `onChange = (patch) => dispatch({type:"updateQuestion", id, patch})` and hands that single `(patch: Partial<Question>) => void` down to `QuestionTypePicker`, `AnswerOptionsEditor`, `QuestionCodingCard`, `BehaviourSettingsCard`, `VisibilityConditionsCard`. Only `SubQuestionsList` (and the card's own delete kebab) receive raw `dispatch`, because they need `select`/`addQuestion`/`removeQuestions`/`moveQuestion(s)`. `updateQuestion` merges with a shallow `{...q, ...patch}`, so nested writes (`styling_metadata`) must be spread by the caller.
7	
8	**Rehostability into a right inspector.** The four `{question, onChange}` cards — Coding, Behaviour, Visibility, AnswerOptions — are genuinely self-contained and hold no builder-shell coupling; three of them already render inside `CollapsibleSettingsCard`, the natural inspector section primitive. `VisibilityConditionsCard` additionally needs `allQuestions` (whole tree) to build its target list. Two width hazards: `AnswerOptionsEditor`'s custom-options `<Table>` (4 columns) and `VisibilityConditionsCard`'s `sm:grid-cols-2` — `sm:` is *viewport*-based, so on a desktop it fires even inside a 320px panel and squeezes the operator/answer selects. `SubQuestionsList` should not be rehosted: its job (child ordering, move, delete, select) is exactly what a left outline tree + canvas do in 3-pane; only its `styling_metadata.containerClasses` layout preset select is worth salvaging into the inspector's group section.
9	
10	**Nesting cap is the biggest structural blocker.** `numberQuestions` in `shared/questionTree.ts` numbers only top-level + immediate children; `findQuestionNumber` returns undefined for grandchildren (the page falls back to the top-level ordinal), and `QuestionTreeNav` renders exactly two levels. Any WYSIWYG canvas supporting arbitrary depth needs this rewritten.
11	
12	**Test IDs: there are none.** A repo-wide grep for `data-cy`/`data-testid` across `src/components/QuestionnaireV2/` returns zero hits. The only DOM ids are `question-title-${question.id}` and `import-questions-url`. The 23 Playwright specs under `tests/facility/settings/questionnaires/` select **entirely by ARIA role + accessible name**, so every `aria-label`, visually-hidden `<Label>`, `role="radio"`/`checkbox` on `ChoiceChip`, and `CollapsibleSettingsCard`'s title-as-trigger-aria-label is a hard contract. `tests/helper/questionnaireV2.ts` additionally depends on `[data-slot="command-input"]` and `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]` (shadcn/radix internals) and on the `combobox` named "Select a value set".
13	
14	**i18n**: flat single-namespace `public/locale/en.json`, snake_case keys, `useTranslation()`/`t()` everywhere, `eslint i18next/no-literal-string` enforced. Dynamic key patterns: `question_type__${type}`, `structured_type__${value}`, `t(entry.description)` → `question_type_*_description`, `t(operator)` → `equals`/`not_equals`/`exists`/`greater`/`less`/`greater_or_equals`/`less_or_equals`, `layout_*`. Interpolated: `configured_count`/`sub_questions_selected`/`move_n_questions` (`{{count}}`), `condition_n` (`{{n}}`), and the only true plural `conditions_count_one`/`conditions_count_other`. Behaviour flags map field key → *different* label key (`repeats`→`repeatable`, `is_component`→`component`).
15	
16	## CONTRACTS
17	- ZERO data-cy / data-testid attributes exist anywhere in src/components/QuestionnaireV2/. All 23 Playwright specs select by ARIA role + accessible name, so every aria-label and visible label string is a test contract. Renaming a label breaks tests silently.
18	- The only DOM ids in builder/ are `question-title-${question.id}` (title Input, paired with an sr-only Label) and `import-questions-url`.
19	- The title input's accessible name comes from a VISUALLY HIDDEN <Label htmlFor> reading t('question_title') -> 'Question Title'. The ordinal ('3.1.') is a sibling <span>, deliberately NOT part of the accessible name. Tests use getByRole('textbox', {name: 'Question Title'}).
20	- QuestionTreeNav rows are <button> elements whose accessible name is `${number} ${text}`; the type icon span is aria-hidden so it never pollutes the name. Tests do getByRole('button', {name: questionTitle}) (substring match).
21	- CollapsibleSettingsCard's chevron trigger uses aria-label={title}. Tests select sections via getByRole('button', {name: 'Coding Details', exact: true}) and {name: 'Question Visibility Conditions'}. Any inspector rehost must preserve title-as-trigger-name.
22	- tests/helper/questionnaireV2.ts depends on shadcn/radix internals: [data-slot="command-input"] and [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper], plus a combobox whose text is 'Select a value set'. The comment warns the search MUST be scoped to the opened popover/dialog or it flakes.
23	- builderReducer 'updateQuestion' does a SHALLOW merge `{...q, ...patch}`. Nested writes (styling_metadata) must spread the existing object themselves — see SubQuestionsList.handleLayoutChange.
24	- mapTree only recurses into a question's children when `question.questions?.length || question.type === 'group'`. Dispatching addQuestion with a non-group parentId that has no existing children is a silent no-op.
25	- The load-time effect in QuestionnaireBuilderPage skips reset while state.dirty is true. Without this a background refetch (refetchOnReconnect) silently discards unsaved edits. Any new shell must keep this guard.
26	- previewQuestionnaire MUST stay a stable useMemo over [questionnaire, state.questions]. QuestionnaireRendererProvider re-seeds its jotai store (wiping in-progress preview answers) whenever that object identity changes.
27	- There is no discard/revert action. 'Cancel' just navigates to backPath; useNavigationPrompt(state.dirty, t('unsaved_changes_warning')) is the only guard. A 3-pane redesign adding an explicit Discard must dispatch reset from the cached questionnaire.
28	- Boolean enable_when answers persist as the STRINGS 'Yes'/'No', never JSON booleans. normalizeBooleanConditionAnswer lives in builderReducer.ts so the editor display path and migrateLegacyBooleanEnableWhen cannot drift. Load-time migration runs inside the 'reset' case and keeps dirty:false (the repair lands with the next save).
29	- enable_when[].question references a target's link_id (NOT id). enable_when target lists must exclude the question's own subtree via collectIds and exclude NON_RESPONSE_TYPES (['group','display']) — targeting one hides the question forever with zero feedback.
30	- regenerateQuestionIds builds an old->new link_id map for the WHOLE tree first, then rewrites enable_when.question through it; conditions whose target isn't in the map are DROPPED, not left dangling. Only the first occurrence of a duplicate link_id claims the map entry.
31	- Quantity answer configuration is valueset-ONLY (legacy contract). QuantityUnitsEditor actively clears answer_option when a valueset is picked. Save is blocked if a quantity question has neither answer_value_set nor grandfathered answer_option (backend 400).
32	- AnswerOptionsEditor keeps a transient `modeOverride` keyed by question.id (Custom vs Value Set tab can be open before a valueset is picked). Seeding an empty `answer_value_set: {}` on the question instead would persist and break both renderers. If the inspector remounts this per selection, key it by question.id.
33	- Question.code MUST be a member of the CARE_OBSERVATION_VALUSET ('system-observation') — arbitrary typed codes are rejected at save. QuestionCodingCard therefore offers search-only selection and never a free-text field.
34	- Switching a question away from 'group' while it still has sub-questions is blocked with toast t('group_type_change_blocked'). Switching to a NON_REPEATABLE_TYPES type (boolean/group/display/structured) also force-clears `repeats` so the flag can't linger invisibly.
35	- Question-level `unit` is written from TWO places: QuestionEditorCard's plain unit row for UNIT_ROW_TYPES = ['integer','decimal','choice'], and QuantityUnitsEditor's Default Unit for quantity. `answer_unit` is deliberately NOT edited (the backend Question spec drops it).
36	- styling_metadata.containerClasses lays out a group's sub-question container (LAYOUT_OPTIONS presets: 'grid grid-cols-1' | 'grid grid-cols-2' | 'grid grid-cols-[2fr_1fr]' | 'grid grid-cols-[1fr_2fr]'); styling_metadata.classes decorates the outer container and is NOT editable in the builder today. Both must render only through sanitizeStylingClasses.
37	- Question fields NO builder card currently edits: styling_metadata.classes, disabled_display, max_length, answer_constraint, answer_unit, is_observation, formula, templates. AnswerOption.display is deliberately omitted (backend spec has no display field).
38	- numberQuestions() numbers only top-level + immediate children; findQuestionNumber() returns undefined for grandchildren+ and callers must fall back to the top-level ordinal. QuestionTreeNav renders exactly two levels. Arbitrary-depth nesting in a 3-pane outline requires rewriting both.
39	- Prev/Next pagination and the tree's insert-'+' separators operate on TOP-LEVEL indices only (findTopLevelIndex maps any nested id to its top-level ancestor).
40	- moveQuestions no-ops entirely when targetParentId is inside the moved subtree (the parent won't exist after excision). removeQuestions re-selects questions[0] only if the removed subtree contained the current selection.
41	- Save-time rules live ONLY in saveValidation.ts SAVE_CHECKS; the page loops over findFirstInvalidQuestion's result, so adding a rule needs no page change. Order matters — the first matching check wins and its question is selected + view forced to 'edit'.
42	- shared/ must never import from builder/. That is why QUESTION_TYPE_ICONS lives in shared/questionTypeIcons.ts (QuestionTreeNav renders it) and why saveValidation's NON_RESPONSE_TYPES is imported downward by VisibilityConditionsCard, not the reverse. manage/ and builder/ never import each other.
43	- QUESTION_TYPE_ICONS is a TOTAL Record<QuestionType, ...> — adding a question type without an icon will not compile. QuestionTypeBadge's TYPE_CLASSES is a Partial record with a gray fallback and DIVERGENT colors (group purple vs icon blue, choice yellow vs orange, structured indigo vs purple).
44	- i18n: flat single-namespace public/locale/en.json, snake_case keys, eslint rule i18next/no-literal-string is enforced (ImportQuestionsDialog needs an explicit eslint-disable for its example URL placeholder).
45	- Dynamic i18n key patterns: `question_type__${type}`, `structured_type__${value}`, t(entry.description) -> `question_type_*_description`, and t(operator) keyed by the RAW operator token (equals / not_equals / exists / greater / less / greater_or_equals / less_or_equals). Layout presets use `layout_single_column|layout_two_columns|layout_wide_start|layout_wide_end`.
46	- i18n interpolation keys: configured_count ({{count}}), sub_questions_selected ({{count}}), move_n_questions ({{count}}), condition_n ({{n}}). The only true plural is conditions_count_one / conditions_count_other — there is no bare `conditions_count` entry.
47	- BehaviourSettingsCard maps the Question field key to a DIFFERENT label key: repeats->'repeatable', is_component->'component', read_only->'read_only'. The 'Configured • N' badge count is derived from the same filtered flag lists that render the chips.
48	- AnswerOptionsEditor's custom-options <Table> is 4 columns (#, Option Value, Default, Action) and VisibilityConditionsCard uses `grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2`. `sm:` is VIEWPORT-based, not container-based, so both will overflow/squeeze inside a ~320-360px right inspector on a desktop viewport — needs container queries or forced single column.
49	- ChoiceChip renders role=radio/checkbox on a bare <button>; in BehaviourSettingsCard and VisibilityConditionsCard they are NOT wrapped in a role=radiogroup (only the quantity unit preview is). Tests do getByRole('radio', {name: 'Any condition is true (OR)'}) directly.
50	- The `?import=1` deep link is gated by canWrite (the whole ImportQuestionsDialog is only mounted when canWrite), and the param is stripped on mount with setQueryParams(rest, {overwrite: true, replace: true}) so refresh/Back doesn't reopen it.
51	- Save must go through buildUpdateBody — a partial PUT would drop fields the builder doesn't own (subject_type, version, code, status). version is coerced via String() because QuestionnaireRead.version can be a bare number.
52	- useUpdateQuestionnaire does setQueryData BEFORE invalidateQueries; relying on the invalidation refetch alone leaves a one-round-trip window where a second quick save composes from stale cache and silently reverts.
53	- isPermissionLoading is folded into the page's loading branch so write affordances (Save Changes, Import) don't pop in after the facility query resolves.
54	- New Question shape from newQuestion(): {id: crypto.randomUUID(), link_id: `Q-${uuid.slice(0,8)}`, text: '', type: 'string', questions: []}.

## SUMMARY
**Shell.** `QuestionnaireBuilderPage` (props `{scope: QuestionnaireScope, id: string}`) is mounted at `/facility/:fid/settings/questionnaires/:id/edit` (src/pages/Facility/settings/layout.tsx:283) and `/admin/questionnaires/:id/edit` (src/Routers/routes/adminRoutes.tsx:39). It fetches via `useQuery(questionnaireKeys.detail(id))`, holds ALL edit state in `useReducer(builderReducer, {questions:[], selectedId:null, dirty:false})`, and re-seeds from the server only when `questionnaire` changes AND `!state.dirty` (guard against refetch clobbering edits). Query params: `?mode=preview` seeds the view, `?import=1` opens the import dialog then is stripped from the URL on mount. `useNavigationPrompt(state.dirty, t("unsaved_changes_warning"))` is the only "discard" protection — the Cancel button is a plain `navigate(backPath)` with **no reducer-level revert**. Save = `findFirstInvalidQuestion(state.questions)` → on failure `toast.error(t(messageKey))` + `dispatch({type:"select"})` + `setView("edit")`; on success `save(buildUpdateBody(questionnaire, {questions}))` through `useUpdateQuestionnaire(id, onSaved)` whose `onSaved` dispatches `reset` with `keepSelectedId` so the author keeps their place. Save is `disabled={!state.dirty || isPending}` and gated on `canWrite`.

**Layout today is 2-pane, one-question-at-a-time.** Header strip: Back + `EditPreviewToggle` | Cancel link + Save Changes. Edit view: `w-72` sticky left `BuilderTreeNav` (`md:` only) + a `md:hidden` `<Select>` mobile fallback + `flex-1` column holding a single `QuestionEditorCard` (or `BuilderEmptyState`) and a sticky bottom Previous / Add new question / Next bar that paginates **top-level questions only** via `findTopLevelIndex`. Preview view swaps the whole body for `QuestionnaireRenderer` fed a `useMemo`'d `{...questionnaire, questions: state.questions}` — that memo identity is load-bearing (the renderer's jotai store re-seeds and wipes in-progress preview answers on identity change).

**State flow reducer→cards is uniform and shallow.** `QuestionEditorCard` derives `onChange = (patch) => dispatch({type:"updateQuestion", id, patch})` and hands that single `(patch: Partial<Question>) => void` down to `QuestionTypePicker`, `AnswerOptionsEditor`, `QuestionCodingCard`, `BehaviourSettingsCard`, `VisibilityConditionsCard`. Only `SubQuestionsList` (and the card's own delete kebab) receive raw `dispatch`, because they need `select`/`addQuestion`/`removeQuestions`/`moveQuestion(s)`. `updateQuestion` merges with a shallow `{...q, ...patch}`, so nested writes (`styling_metadata`) must be spread by the caller.

**Rehostability into a right inspector.** The four `{question, onChange}` cards — Coding, Behaviour, Visibility, AnswerOptions — are genuinely self-contained and hold no builder-shell coupling; three of them already render inside `CollapsibleSettingsCard`, the natural inspector section primitive. `VisibilityConditionsCard` additionally needs `allQuestions` (whole tree) to build its target list. Two width hazards: `AnswerOptionsEditor`'s custom-options `<Table>` (4 columns) and `VisibilityConditionsCard`'s `sm:grid-cols-2` — `sm:` is *viewport*-based, so on a desktop it fires even inside a 320px panel and squeezes the operator/answer selects. `SubQuestionsList` should not be rehosted: its job (child ordering, move, delete, select) is exactly what a left outline tree + canvas do in 3-pane; only its `styling_metadata.containerClasses` layout preset select is worth salvaging into the inspector's group section.

**Nesting cap is the biggest structural blocker.** `numberQuestions` in `shared/questionTree.ts` numbers only top-level + immediate children; `findQuestionNumber` returns undefined for grandchildren (the page falls back to the top-level ordinal), and `QuestionTreeNav` renders exactly two levels. Any WYSIWYG canvas supporting arbitrary depth needs this rewritten.

**Test IDs: there are none.** A repo-wide grep for `data-cy`/`data-testid` across `src/components/QuestionnaireV2/` returns zero hits. The only DOM ids are `question-title-${question.id}` and `import-questions-url`. The 23 Playwright specs under `tests/facility/settings/questionnaires/` select **entirely by ARIA role + accessible name**, so every `aria-label`, visually-hidden `<Label>`, `role="radio"`/`checkbox` on `ChoiceChip`, and `CollapsibleSettingsCard`'s title-as-trigger-aria-label is a hard contract. `tests/helper/questionnaireV2.ts` additionally depends on `[data-slot="command-input"]` and `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]` (shadcn/radix internals) and on the `combobox` named "Select a value set".

**i18n**: flat single-namespace `public/locale/en.json`, snake_case keys, `useTranslation()`/`t()` everywhere, `eslint i18next/no-literal-string` enforced. Dynamic key patterns: `question_type__${type}`, `structured_type__${value}`, `t(entry.description)` → `question_type_*_description`, `t(operator)` → `equals`/`not_equals`/`exists`/`greater`/`less`/`greater_or_equals`/`less_or_equals`, `layout_*`. Interpolated: `configured_count`/`sub_questions_selected`/`move_n_questions` (`{{count}}`), `condition_n` (`{{n}}`), and the only true plural `conditions_count_one`/`conditions_count_other`. Behaviour flags map field key → *different* label key (`repeats`→`repeatable`, `is_component`→`component`).

## CONTRACTS
- ZERO data-cy / data-testid attributes exist anywhere in src/components/QuestionnaireV2/. All 23 Playwright specs select by ARIA role + accessible name, so every aria-label and visible label string is a test contract. Renaming a label breaks tests silently.
- The only DOM ids in builder/ are `question-title-${question.id}` (title Input, paired with an sr-only Label) and `import-questions-url`.
- The title input's accessible name comes from a VISUALLY HIDDEN <Label htmlFor> reading t('question_title') -> 'Question Title'. The ordinal ('3.1.') is a sibling <span>, deliberately NOT part of the accessible name. Tests use getByRole('textbox', {name: 'Question Title'}).
- QuestionTreeNav rows are <button> elements whose accessible name is `${number} ${text}`; the type icon span is aria-hidden so it never pollutes the name. Tests do getByRole('button', {name: questionTitle}) (substring match).
- CollapsibleSettingsCard's chevron trigger uses aria-label={title}. Tests select sections via getByRole('button', {name: 'Coding Details', exact: true}) and {name: 'Question Visibility Conditions'}. Any inspector rehost must preserve title-as-trigger-name.
- tests/helper/questionnaireV2.ts depends on shadcn/radix internals: [data-slot="command-input"] and [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper], plus a combobox whose text is 'Select a value set'. The comment warns the search MUST be scoped to the opened popover/dialog or it flakes.
- builderReducer 'updateQuestion' does a SHALLOW merge `{...q, ...patch}`. Nested writes (styling_metadata) must spread the existing object themselves — see SubQuestionsList.handleLayoutChange.
- mapTree only recurses into a question's children when `question.questions?.length || question.type === 'group'`. Dispatching addQuestion with a non-group parentId that has no existing children is a silent no-op.
- The load-time effect in QuestionnaireBuilderPage skips reset while state.dirty is true. Without this a background refetch (refetchOnReconnect) silently discards unsaved edits. Any new shell must keep this guard.
- previewQuestionnaire MUST stay a stable useMemo over [questionnaire, state.questions]. QuestionnaireRendererProvider re-seeds its jotai store (wiping in-progress preview answers) whenever that object identity changes.
- There is no discard/revert action. 'Cancel' just navigates to backPath; useNavigationPrompt(state.dirty, t('unsaved_changes_warning')) is the only guard. A 3-pane redesign adding an explicit Discard must dispatch reset from the cached questionnaire.
- Boolean enable_when answers persist as the STRINGS 'Yes'/'No', never JSON booleans. normalizeBooleanConditionAnswer lives in builderReducer.ts so the editor display path and migrateLegacyBooleanEnableWhen cannot drift. Load-time migration runs inside the 'reset' case and keeps dirty:false (the repair lands with the next save).
- enable_when[].question references a target's link_id (NOT id). enable_when target lists must exclude the question's own subtree via collectIds and exclude NON_RESPONSE_TYPES (['group','display']) — targeting one hides the question forever with zero feedback.
- regenerateQuestionIds builds an old->new link_id map for the WHOLE tree first, then rewrites enable_when.question through it; conditions whose target isn't in the map are DROPPED, not left dangling. Only the first occurrence of a duplicate link_id claims the map entry.
- Quantity answer configuration is valueset-ONLY (legacy contract). QuantityUnitsEditor actively clears answer_option when a valueset is picked. Save is blocked if a quantity question has neither answer_value_set nor grandfathered answer_option (backend 400).
- AnswerOptionsEditor keeps a transient `modeOverride` keyed by question.id (Custom vs Value Set tab can be open before a valueset is picked). Seeding an empty `answer_value_set: {}` on the question instead would persist and break both renderers. If the inspector remounts this per selection, key it by question.id.
- Question.code MUST be a member of the CARE_OBSERVATION_VALUSET ('system-observation') — arbitrary typed codes are rejected at save. QuestionCodingCard therefore offers search-only selection and never a free-text field.
- Switching a question away from 'group' while it still has sub-questions is blocked with toast t('group_type_change_blocked'). Switching to a NON_REPEATABLE_TYPES type (boolean/group/display/structured) also force-clears `repeats` so the flag can't linger invisibly.
- Question-level `unit` is written from TWO places: QuestionEditorCard's plain unit row for UNIT_ROW_TYPES = ['integer','decimal','choice'], and QuantityUnitsEditor's Default Unit for quantity. `answer_unit` is deliberately NOT edited (the backend Question spec drops it).
- styling_metadata.containerClasses lays out a group's sub-question container (LAYOUT_OPTIONS presets: 'grid grid-cols-1' | 'grid grid-cols-2' | 'grid grid-cols-[2fr_1fr]' | 'grid grid-cols-[1fr_2fr]'); styling_metadata.classes decorates the outer container and is NOT editable in the builder today. Both must render only through sanitizeStylingClasses.
- Question fields NO builder card currently edits: styling_metadata.classes, disabled_display, max_length, answer_constraint, answer_unit, is_observation, formula, templates. AnswerOption.display is deliberately omitted (backend spec has no display field).
- numberQuestions() numbers only top-level + immediate children; findQuestionNumber() returns undefined for grandchildren+ and callers must fall back to the top-level ordinal. QuestionTreeNav renders exactly two levels. Arbitrary-depth nesting in a 3-pane outline requires rewriting both.
- Prev/Next pagination and the tree's insert-'+' separators operate on TOP-LEVEL indices only (findTopLevelIndex maps any nested id to its top-level ancestor).
- moveQuestions no-ops entirely when targetParentId is inside the moved subtree (the parent won't exist after excision). removeQuestions re-selects questions[0] only if the removed subtree contained the current selection.
- Save-time rules live ONLY in saveValidation.ts SAVE_CHECKS; the page loops over findFirstInvalidQuestion's result, so adding a rule needs no page change. Order matters — the first matching check wins and its question is selected + view forced to 'edit'.
- shared/ must never import from builder/. That is why QUESTION_TYPE_ICONS lives in shared/questionTypeIcons.ts (QuestionTreeNav renders it) and why saveValidation's NON_RESPONSE_TYPES is imported downward by VisibilityConditionsCard, not the reverse. manage/ and builder/ never import each other.
- QUESTION_TYPE_ICONS is a TOTAL Record<QuestionType, ...> — adding a question type without an icon will not compile. QuestionTypeBadge's TYPE_CLASSES is a Partial record with a gray fallback and DIVERGENT colors (group purple vs icon blue, choice yellow vs orange, structured indigo vs purple).
- i18n: flat single-namespace public/locale/en.json, snake_case keys, eslint rule i18next/no-literal-string is enforced (ImportQuestionsDialog needs an explicit eslint-disable for its example URL placeholder).
- Dynamic i18n key patterns: `question_type__${type}`, `structured_type__${value}`, t(entry.description) -> `question_type_*_description`, and t(operator) keyed by the RAW operator token (equals / not_equals / exists / greater / less / greater_or_equals / less_or_equals). Layout presets use `layout_single_column|layout_two_columns|layout_wide_start|layout_wide_end`.
- i18n interpolation keys: configured_count ({{count}}), sub_questions_selected ({{count}}), move_n_questions ({{count}}), condition_n ({{n}}). The only true plural is conditions_count_one / conditions_count_other — there is no bare `conditions_count` entry.
- BehaviourSettingsCard maps the Question field key to a DIFFERENT label key: repeats->'repeatable', is_component->'component', read_only->'read_only'. The 'Configured • N' badge count is derived from the same filtered flag lists that render the chips.
- AnswerOptionsEditor's custom-options <Table> is 4 columns (#, Option Value, Default, Action) and VisibilityConditionsCard uses `grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2`. `sm:` is VIEWPORT-based, not container-based, so both will overflow/squeeze inside a ~320-360px right inspector on a desktop viewport — needs container queries or forced single column.
- ChoiceChip renders role=radio/checkbox on a bare <button>; in BehaviourSettingsCard and VisibilityConditionsCard they are NOT wrapped in a role=radiogroup (only the quantity unit preview is). Tests do getByRole('radio', {name: 'Any condition is true (OR)'}) directly.
- The `?import=1` deep link is gated by canWrite (the whole ImportQuestionsDialog is only mounted when canWrite), and the param is stripped on mount with setQueryParams(rest, {overwrite: true, replace: true}) so refresh/Back doesn't reopen it.
- Save must go through buildUpdateBody — a partial PUT would drop fields the builder doesn't own (subject_type, version, code, status). version is coerced via String() because QuestionnaireRead.version can be a bare number.
- useUpdateQuestionnaire does setQueryData BEFORE invalidateQueries; relying on the invalidation refetch alone leaves a one-round-trip window where a second quick save composes from stale cache and silently reverts.
- isPermissionLoading is folded into the page's loading branch so write affordances (Save Changes, Import) don't pop in after the facility query resolves.
- New Question shape from newQuestion(): {id: crypto.randomUUID(), link_id: `Q-${uuid.slice(0,8)}`, text: '', type: 'string', questions: []}.

32	- The type picker popover must contain a `[data-slot="command-input"]` reachable as `.last()` for filtering; questionnaireQuantityUnit and questionnaireUnitSemantics filter first because an unfiltered list overflows the viewport and leaves `quantity` unclickable.
33	- Editor kebab: `button "More options"` in the editor header must be the FIRST such button, with sub-question row kebabs after it (questionnaireBuilderGroups uses `.last()` for the child row). 35	- Behaviour card: `checkbox "Required"` and `checkbox "Repeatable"` reporting state via `aria-checked`; `Repeatable` must NOT render for boolean type and must reset to false when the type changes; the card summary must render the literal text `"Configured • N"`.
36	- Visibility conditions: `button "Add a condition"`; each condition row is a `div` whose class contains `sm:grid-cols-2` (indexed with `.nth(i)` for multi-condition tests); within it comboboxes at indices 0=target question, 1=operator, 2=answer, plus `getByRole("spinbutton")` for numeric answers; the row label text `"Condition 1"`; `button "Delete"` exact removes it.
37	- Condition operator options must include exact-named `"Equals"`, `"Greater Than"`, and a distinct `"Greater Than or Equal"` (asserted visible when the target is numeric); boolean answers offer `option "Yes"` / `"No"` exact.
38	- Condition target picker must NEVER list group or display questions; a saved condition targeting one must surface the inline text "Visibility conditions can't target group or display questions" and block save.
39	- Behaviour radio `"Any condition is true (OR)"` must exist and, when selected, render a joiner chip with the exact text `"or"` between condition rows.
40	- Answer options editor: mode radios `"Custom Options"` and `"Value Set"`; `button "Add Option"`; options rendered as `role="row"` with the header at index 0 (options start at `nth(1)`); each row has a `textbox` value input, `radio "Default"` with aria-checked, `button "Move Up"`, and a `button "More options"` kebab; a page-level `button "Clear default"` that becomes disabled when no default is set.
41	- Quantity questions are valueset-only: `radio "Custom Options"` and `button "Add Option"` must NOT render, the text `"Unit Options"` must be visible, and saving without a valueset must be blocked client-side with the exact toast "Quantity questions need a unit value set — pick one under Unit Options".
42	- Valueset autocomplete contract (pickValuesetFromAutocomplete): trigger is `getByRole("combobox").filter({ hasText: "Select a value set" })`; the popover must be a `role="dialog"` or `[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper]` containing `[data-slot="command-input"]`; after selection the same combobox must read the valueset name (e.g. "UCUM Units"). Search must be scoped to the popover — a bare `[data-slot="command-input"].first()` can resolve to a different cmdk input on the builder page (documented flake).
43	- Unit fields: quantity uses `combobox "Default Unit"`; integer/decimal use `combobox "Unit"`; the preview-side per-answer picker is `combobox "Unit"` with `exact: true`. All are driven through `selectFromValueSet` from tests/helper/ui.ts, which needs a visible trigger, a dialog-or-popper scope, `[data-slot="command-input"]`, and `role="option"` results.
44	- Coding card bound state must expose the text `"Code Verified"`, a `/LOINC: \S+/` text node, `combobox "Change"`, and `button "Remove"`; unbinding must restore `combobox "Search for observation codes"`. Opening and Escaping the code search must not unmount the editor (explicit FormProvider crash regression guard).
45	- Group editor: layout preset is a combobox inside the editor card filtered by `hasText: "Single column"` with `option "Two columns"`; the preset must render in preview as `fieldset[class*="grid-cols-2"]`.
46	- Sub-questions list: `button "Add Sub-Question"`; each child row exposes `getByRole("checkbox", { name: <child title> })` and `getByRole("button", { name: <child title> })`; the bulk bar shows the literal `"N sub-questions selected"` with `button "Clear Selection"`, `button "Delete"` exact, and `button "Move N questions"`.
47	- Move dialog: `getByRole("dialog", { name: "Move 1 questions" })` containing one `combobox` (destination, with `option "Top Level"` and one option per group), one `spinbutton` (position index), and `button "Move"` exact.
48	- Changing a group's type while sub-questions exist must be rejected with the toast "Remove sub-questions before changing this question's type" and the type picker must still read "Group".
49	- The editor card must remain matchable as `page.locator('[data-slot="card"]')` — questionnaireBuilderGroups uses it as the scope that separates sub-question rows from identically-named tree-nav rows.
50	- Import dialog: `button "Import Questions"` opens `dialog "Import Questionnaire"`; it must contain a `combobox` with `option "Import from URL"`, a `textbox "Paste a questionnaire JSON URL"`, a real `input[type="file"]` (queried page-level, not via a drop event), dropzone text "Drag and drop file here or click to upload", confirm-step texts "Question count: N" / "Warning" / "All existing data will be replaced", and buttons `"Import"` (exact), `"Back"`, `"Cancel"`.
51	- Import error strings are asserted verbatim: inline "Please enter a valid url", and "Invalid JSON: please check the format and try again" (shown inline for a bad file, as a toast for a bad fetched payload).
52	- Import must land the caller on question 1 (the title textbox shows the first imported question) and must remap link_ids, dropping enable_when conditions whose target link_id is unknown — questionnaireEnableWhenMatrix relies on this by scaffolding a mutual cycle to build an all-hidden form.
53	- Save button: `button "Save Changes"`, disabled until the draft is dirty, absent entirely for users without write permission, and emitting exactly one PUT to `/api/v1/questionnaire/{id}/`. Four specs count PUT/POST requests and assert `toHaveLength(0)` when validation fails.
54	- Save validation toasts are asserted verbatim: "Every question needs a title", "Group questions must contain at least one sub-question", "Every visibility condition needs a target question", "Visibility conditions can't target group or display questions — pick a question that records an answer", "Quantity questions need a unit value set — pick one under Unit Options".
55	- Success/error toasts asserted verbatim: "Questionnaire created successfully", "Questionnaire updated successfully", "Questionnaire Imported Successfully" (capital I/S), "Questionnaire cloned successfully", "Organizations updated", "Something went wrong..!".
56	- On a failed save (500) the editor must retain the unsaved draft, stay on /edit, and keep `Save Changes` enabled for retry.
57	- Mode toggle: `button "Preview"` and `button "Edit"` (exact) must both exist and switch in place without a full navigation; `button "Back"` must return to the detail URL matching `/\/settings\/questionnaires\/[0-9a-f-]+$/`.
58	- Footer pager `button "Previous"` / `button "Next"` must walk top-level questions and be disabled at the first/last question. Note `"Next"` is also the preview renderer's page-advance button (questionnaireEnableWhen asserts it is disabled while a required-gating condition is unmet) — keep the two disambiguated by context or the specs collide.
59	- Preview renderer contracts relied on from the builder: `getByPlaceholder("Enter details")` (string), `textarea` (text), `input[type="url"]`, `role="spinbutton"` with `inputmode` numeric/decimal, `button "Pick a date"`, `input[type="time"]` (disabled until a date is picked for dateTime), `[role="gridcell"]:not([data-outside]) button`, boolean `radio "Yes"/"No"` exact, repeats via `button "Add Another"` / `button "Remove"`, notes via `button "Add note"` + `span.bg-amber-500` dot + `getByPlaceholder("Add note")`, required asterisk `span.text-red-500`, group `heading` + `text "Group"` exact, unit label suffix text like "(mg)", "(/min)", "(Cel)".
60	- Preview empty states asserted verbatim: "No questions added yet!" and "No questions to show — every question in this form is hidden by its visibility conditions."
